steps.title: Design sgRNAs for CRISPRa
steps.instruction: Use CRISPick or another sgRNA design tool for CRISPR activation. Select the appropriate reference genome and Cas enzyme, enter the target gene name, and retrieve the top five promoter‑targeting sequences (or upload enhancer sequences if targeting enhancers).

steps.title: Order primers and make 100 µM stocks
steps.instruction: Order primers containing the required restriction sites (e.g., sasgRNA_F‑Inf‑BstXI: gagaaCCAcctTGTTGG[sgRNA‑seq]gttAtagtactctgg and sasgRNA_RevInf‑XhoI (universal): ggatccTAGTActcgagAAaaaaatctc). Re‑suspend each primer in dH₂O to a final concentration of 100 µM.

steps.title: Prepare sgRNA PCR mix
steps.instruction: In a 0.5 mL PCR tube combine: 1.5 µL 10 µM forward primer, 1.5 µL 10 µM reverse primer, 12.5 µL KOD One™ PCR master mix (1×), <250 ng sgRNA plasmid template, and nuclease‑free water to a final volume of 25 µL (see Recipe 1).

steps.title: Amplify sgRNA fragment by PCR
steps.instruction: Run PCR with the following program (Table 1): 98 °C 1 min initial denaturation; 32 cycles of 98 °C 10 s, 60 °C 5 s, 68 °C 2 s; final extension 68 °C 1 min (15–30 s per kb).

steps.title: Measure DNA concentration
steps.instruction: Determine the concentration of the PCR product using a spectrophotometer or fluorometer.

steps.title: Digest AAV backbone
steps.instruction: In a 50 µL reaction mix add 1 µg AAV backbone plasmid, 1 µL BstXI (Fisher Scientific, cat #FD1024), 1 µL XhoI (Fisher Scientific, cat #FD0694), 5 µL 10× FastDigest green buffer (Fisher Scientific, cat #FD1024), and nuclease‑free water to 50 µL. Incubate 1–3 h at the temperature recommended by the enzymes.

steps.title: Prepare 1 % agarose gel
steps.instruction: Dissolve 0.5 g SeaKem® LE agarose (Lonza, cat #50004) in 50 mL 1× TAE (or appropriate buffer) and melt. Cool to ~60 °C, add GelRed or equivalent, pour into a gel tray with a comb, and allow to solidify.

steps.title: Run gel and excise bands
steps.instruction: Load the digested AAV backbone and the sgRNA PCR product onto the 1 % agarose gel, run at 100 V until separation is sufficient, visualize under UV, and excise the bands corresponding to the linearized vector and the sgRNA insert.

steps.title: Extract DNA from gel slices
steps.instruction: Use the QIAquick Gel Extraction kit (Qiagen, cat #28704) according to the manufacturer’s protocol to purify the vector and insert DNA from the excised gel pieces.

steps.title: Set up NEBuilder HiFi assembly
steps.instruction: In a 20 µL reaction combine 50 ng digested vector, 10 ng sgRNA insert, 10 µL NEBuilder® HiFi DNA Assembly master mix (NEB, cat #E2621), and nuclease‑free water to 20 µL (see Recipe 3).

steps.title: Incubate assembly reaction
steps.instruction: Place the assembly mix in a thermocycler at 50 °C for 15 min if assembling 2–3 fragments, or for 60 min if assembling 4–6 fragments.

steps.title: Transform Stellar competent cells
steps.instruction: Thaw Stellar™ competent cells (Takara Bio, cat #636766) on ice. Add 2 µL of the chilled assembly reaction to 50 µL cells, incubate on ice 30 min, heat‑shock at 42 °C for 30 s, return to ice 2 min, add 450 µL SOC medium, and recover at 37 °C, 250 × g for 1 h.

steps.title: Plate transformed cells on LB‑ampicillin
steps.instruction: Spread 100 µL of the recovery culture onto LB agar plates containing ampicillin (1 mg/mL; prepared by adding 100 µL of 100 mg/mL ampicillin stock to 10 L LB; ampicillin sodium salt powder, Corning, cat #61‑238‑RM). Incubate overnight at 37 °C.

steps.title: Inoculate overnight LB culture
steps.instruction: Pick a single colony, inoculate into 3 mL LB broth (Luria Broth base, 25 g/L; Fisher, cat #12795084) supplemented with ampicillin (1:500 dilution of 100 mg/mL stock). Grow at 37 °C with shaking at 250 × g for 7–8 h.

steps.title: Perform plasmid miniprep
steps.instruction: Harvest the overnight culture and isolate plasmid DNA using the QiaPrep Spin MiniPrep kit (Qiagen, cat #27104) following the manufacturer’s protocol.

steps.title: Validate sgRNA insertion by sequencing
steps.instruction: Submit the purified plasmid for Sanger sequencing using primers flanking the cloning site to confirm correct sgRNA insertion.

steps.title: Store plasmid stocks
steps.instruction: Aliquot the confirmed plasmid DNA and store at –20 °C.

steps.title: Prepare preadipocyte culturing medium
steps.instruction: Combine DMEM, high glucose (Fisher Scientific, cat #11‑965‑118) 445 mL (89 %), heat‑inactivated FBS (Fisher Scientific, cat #10438026) 50 mL (10 %), and penicillin‑streptomycin (Fisher Scientific, cat #15140122) 5 mL (1 %) to a final volume of 500 mL. Pre‑warm medium and Trypsin‑EDTA (0.25 %, Fisher Scientific, cat #25200056) to 37 °C.

steps.title: Thaw and maintain preadipocytes
steps.instruction: Rapidly thaw frozen human preadipocytes, seed in pre‑warmed culturing medium, and keep cultures below 80 % confluency (avoid >85 % as it impairs differentiation).

steps.title: Seed cells for differentiation
steps.instruction: When cells reach ~70 % confluency, wash with DPBS (no Ca²⁺/Mg²⁺, Fisher, cat #14190144), add Trypsin‑EDTA and incubate 5 min at 37 °C, neutralize with preadipocyte medium, collect cells, centrifuge 300 × g 5 min, resuspend in 1 mL medium, count, and seed:

substeps.instruction: 5 × 10⁵ cells per well of a 12‑well plate (for monolayer differentiation).
1.5–5 × 10⁵ cells in 100 µL per well of a Nunclon Sphera‑treated 96‑well U‑shaped plate (for organoid formation).

steps.title: Prepare adipocyte differentiation medium
steps.instruction: For 10 mL total: mix DMEM, high glucose (Fisher Scientific, cat #11‑995‑065) 9 mL (90 %), heat‑inactivated FBS 1 mL (10 %), IBMX 10 µL of 0.5 M stock (Sigma‑Aldrich, cat #410957) to 0.5 mM, dexamethasone 10 µL of 1 mM stock (Sigma‑Aldrich, cat #D1756) to 1 µM, and insulin 10 µL of 10 mg/mL stock (Sigma‑Aldrich, cat #I9278) to 10 µg/mL. Warm to 37 °C before use.

steps.title: Differentiate preadipocytes into adipocytes
steps.instruction: Day 0: Verify cells are 100 % confluent, replace culturing medium with differentiation medium, and incubate 48 h at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂. Change medium every other day for 14–21 days using a pipette (avoid vacuum aspirator). Lipid droplets will become visible as clear circular structures.

steps.title: Differentiate preadipocytes into adipose organoids
steps.instruction: 24–48 h after seeding in the Nunclon Sphera plate, warm differentiation medium to 37 °C, gently remove growth medium without disturbing organoids, add 100 µL differentiation medium to each well, and change half the volume daily for 21–28 days by pipetting out ~50 µL (adjust for evaporation) and adding fresh medium.

steps.title: Prepare CRISPRa transfection mix for adipocytes
steps.instruction: Per well of a 12‑well plate (see Recipe 8): mix 100 µL Opti‑MEM, 1 µg dCas9‑VP64 plasmid (Addgene #115790), 1 µg sgRNA plasmid (Addgene #217015), 2 µL X‑tremeGENE™ HP (Roche, cat #6366236001), and 2 µL Combimag™ reagent (Oz Biosciences, cat #CM21000). Total volume ≈104 µL.

steps.title: Transfect adipocytes on day 4
steps.instruction: On differentiation day 4, replace medium with fresh differentiation medium, add the prepared transfection mix dropwise to each well, incubate on a magnetofection plate for 30 min, then return plates to the 37 °C incubator. Change medium either 6 h later or the next day.

steps.title: AAV transduction of adipocytes
steps.instruction: On differentiation day 2, add AAV particles (either sgRNA‑AAV or dCas9‑VP64‑AAV) at a multiplicity of infection (MOI) of 1 × 10⁶ viral genomes per cell.

steps.title: AAV transduction of adipose organoids
steps.instruction: One week prior to grafting, treat organoid cultures with the same AAV vectors at an MOI of 1 × 10⁶.

steps.title: Purify and titrate AAV particles
steps.instruction: After harvesting AAV‑producing HEK293T supernatant, concentrate virus using an Amicon Ultra centrifugal filter:

substeps.instruction: Load supernatant onto the column and centrifuge at 2,000 × g for 5 min at 15 °C.
Discard flow‑through and add 1 mL suspension buffer per original 150 mm plate to the column.
Repeat centrifugation (2,000 × g, 5 min, 15 °C) up to five times, discarding flow‑through each time.
Collect the final virus suspension in a 1.5 mL tube.
Aliquot 2 µL for titration and store the remaining virus at –80 °C.
Determine viral genome titer using the AAVpro® Titration kit (Takara Bio, cat #6233) according to the manufacturer’s real‑time PCR protocol.

description: Validation of protocol All validation data and information about the analysis are included in the original research article: Nguyen et al. [27] Implantation of engineered adipocytes suppresses tumor progression in cancer models. Nature Biotechnology . The original research article confirms browning activation in white adipocytes after CRISPR activation (Extended Data Figure 1, Nguyen et al. [27]). It also shows that oxygen consumption rates, glucose uptake, and fatty acid oxidation are increased in these CRISPRa-modulated adipocytes (Extended Data Figure 1, Nguyen et al. [27]). Additionally, the protocol to reprogram adipocytes is shown in [27] to be an effective method of metabolic therapy to target cancer. Cancer cell growth is shown to be suppressed when co-cultured with the CRISPRa reprogrammed human adipocytes (Figure 1, Nguyen et al. [27]). Glucose uptake of cancer cells is also reduced when these cells are co-cultured with CRISPRa-modulated human adipocytes (Figure 1, Nguyen et al. [27]). Cancer cells also exhibit decreased glucose utilization, as shown by measurements of the extracellular acidification rate (ECAR) and metabolic gene expression (Figure 1, Nguyen et al. [27]). Using this protocol, UCP1 -CRISPRa-engineered adipose organoids were generated and co-transplanted in mice to suppress the growth of xenografted tumors (Figure 2, Nguyen et al. [27]).
